about.en: Tokamak Network is an Ethereum layer-2 platform for deploying application-specific rollups on demand. Its token is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x2be5e8c109e2197D077D13A82dAead6a9b3433C5 that reports the on-chain symbol TON; exchanges list it as TOKAMAK to avoid the collision with Toncoin, which is a different asset. It is used for staking and in the network's DAO.
